create_streamable_lstm: create a StreamableLSTM module with a given dimension and number of layers for audio sequence modeling
create_streamable_lstm_with_skip: create a StreamableLSTM with skip connection enabled to add input to LSTM output for residual learning
create_streamable_lstm_no_skip: create a StreamableLSTM with skip connection disabled for standard LSTM behavior without residual addition
run_streamable_lstm_forward: run forward pass on convolutional layout tensor through StreamableLSTM to get sequence output
review_streamable_lstm: review the StreamableLSTM class that handles permutation between convolutional and LSTM tensor layouts with optional skip connections
